## ddlapi dev kit

This repository is the ddlapi library. The `ddlapi-authoring` and
`ddlapi-testing` packages (resolved as dependencies) carry the conventions for
working on the model, the parser, and the test suite — their skill triggers
apply whenever you edit `src/**` or `test/**`.

## Files matching `**/*.ts`

<!-- Source: local agent-packages/ddlapi-using/.apm/instructions/ddlapi-using.instructions.md -->
## Skill trigger: `ddlapi-using`

When writing TypeScript that imports `@netcracker/qubership-apihub-ddlapi` —
calling `buildFromDdl`, traversing a `Realm`/`Schema`/`Table`, or constructing
schema objects with its factories — apply the `ddlapi-using` skill.
